items.statement:
Fix integers $N\geq2$ and $k\geq0$ and a real stability parameter $\zeta>0$. Let $V=\mathbb C^k$ and $W=\mathbb C^N$ with Hermitian structures, and let $\mathcal S_{k,N}^\zeta$ be the locus of quadruples $(B_1,B_2,I,J)$ with $B_i\in\operatorname{End}_{\mathbb C}(V)$, $I:W\to V$, and $J:V\to W$, satisfying $[B_1,B_2]+IJ=0$ and the condition that the vectors $B_{i_1}\cdots B_{i_m}I(w)$ span $V$ for all words of length $m\geq0$ and $w\in W$. The group $GL(V)$ acts algebraically by $g\cdot(B_1,B_2,I,J)=(gB_1g^{-1},gB_2g^{-1},gI,Jg^{-1})$. These are algebraic coordinates on the finite-dimensional complex data space; this formal quotient assigns no spacetime units to $B_i,I,J$. The parameter $\zeta$ labels the positive stability chamber and is not assigned a physical dimension here. Let $\pi_{k,N}:\mathcal S_{k,N}^\zeta\to X_{k,N}^\zeta$ be the positive-FI geometric quotient in the classical variety sense: $\pi_{k,N}$ is a surjective invariant morphism whose fibres are precisely the $GL(V)$-orbits; $U\subseteq X_{k,N}^\zeta$ is open exactly when $\pi_{k,N}^{-1}(U)$ is open; and for every such $U$ pullback identifies $\mathcal O_{X_{k,N}^\zeta}(U)$ with $\mathcal O_{\mathcal S_{k,N}^\zeta}(\pi_{k,N}^{-1}(U))^{GL(V)}$. Under the stable positive-FI hypotheses, the supplied stable ADHM quotient result gives this quotient a separated smooth finite-type complex structure of dimension $2kN$ and a finite invariant affine word-slice atlas. The parameter $\zeta$ labels the positive stability chamber; this is not, by definition, the zero-FI regular quotient or the moduli space of anti-self-dual connections.

Let $T_{\mathbb C}=(\mathbb C^\times)^2\times(\mathbb C^\times)^N$ act algebraically, and let $K=(S^1)^2\times(S^1)^N$ be its maximal compact subgroup. The action is $(t_1,t_2,h)\cdot(B_1,B_2,I,J)=(t_1B_1,t_2B_2,Ih^{-1},t_1t_2hJ)$, where $h$ acts on $W$ with weights $e_\alpha^{-1}$. Thus $\mathbf W=\sum_{\alpha=1}^N e_\alpha^{-1}$ and $\mathbf W^\vee=\sum_{\alpha=1}^N e_\alpha$. Write $\epsilon_i=c_1^K(t_i)$ and $a_\alpha=c_1^K(e_\alpha)$; each has mass dimension one in units $c=\hbar=1$. Let $q$ be a dimensionless formal charge-counting variable.

Assume the complexified torus action has a finite proper fixed locus $F_{k,N}$ on each quotient. Extend the torus to $T_m=T_{\mathbb C}\times\mathbb C_m^\times$ with maximal compact subgroup $K_m=K\times S_m^1$; the flavor factor acts trivially on $X_{k,N}^\zeta$. Use the product right Milnor model $E K_m$, and write $B K_m=E K_m/K_m$ and $X_{k,N,K_m}^\zeta=E K_m\times_{K_m}X_{k,N}^\zeta$, with diagonal quotient relation $(e,x)\cdot t=(e\cdot t,t^{-1}\cdot x)$. Equivariant cohomology means $H_{T_m}^*(X_{k,N}^\zeta;\mathbb Q)=H^*(X_{k,N,K_m}^\zeta;\mathbb Q)$. The derivative action makes $TX_{k,N}^\zeta$ a $K_m$-equivariant complex vector bundle, and its Borel descent is $E K_m\times_{K_m}TX_{k,N}^\zeta\to X_{k,N,K_m}^\zeta$. Assume each component of this Borel base has CW type and that the descended bundle, including its tensor products below, is numerable; Chern classes are formed componentwise on a CW model and transported by homotopy invariance. For a numerable complex rank-$n$ bundle $E$ on a connected CW model, its Chern classes are the unique coefficients in the projective-bundle relation $x_E^n-c_1(E)x_E^{n-1}+\cdots+(-1)^nc_n(E)=0$, where $P(E)$ is the bundle of complex lines in the fibers and $x_E=c_1(\gamma_E)$ for the tautological line $\gamma_E\to P(E)$. We use their rational images. For a character $\chi:T_m\to\mathbb C^\times$, let $L_\chi=E K_m\times_{K_m}\mathbb C_{\chi|_{K_m}}\to B K_m$ be its associated line, with right equivalence $(e,z)\cdot t=(e\cdot t,\chi(t)^{-1}z)$, and write $u_\chi=c_1(L_\chi)$. Put $\widetilde m=u_{\chi_m}$ for the defining flavor character, of mass dimension one like $\epsilon_i$ and $a_\alpha$, and let $L_{-1}=L_{\chi_m^{-1}}$; thus its additive weight is $-\widetilde m$. At a fixed point with tangent characters $\chi_1,\ldots,\chi_{2kN}$ and additive weights $w_j=u_{\chi_j}$, pullback to $B K_m$ gives character lines $L_{\chi_j\chi_m^{-1}}$. The top Chern class of a rank-$n$ complex bundle equals the Euler class of its complex-oriented real bundle, and the Euler class is natural and multiplicative for ordered direct sums; for a character line its Euler class is its first Chern class. Therefore the top Chern restriction is $\prod_{j=1}^{2kN}(w_j-\widetilde m)$.

Set $\mathcal E_{\widetilde m}=c_{2kN}^{T_m}(TX_{k,N}^\zeta\otimes L_{-1})\in H_{T_m}^{4kN}(X_{k,N}^\zeta;\mathbb Q)$, where $L_{-1}$ in the tensor product denotes pullback from $B K_m$. At a fixed point with tangent weights $w_1,\ldots,w_{2kN}$, its restriction is $\prod_{j=1}^{2kN}(w_j-\widetilde m)$ by the preceding construction. Let $S_{T_m}$ be generated by the first Chern classes of nontrivial integral characters of $T_m$, put $R_{T_m}=H^*(B K_m;\mathbb Q)=\mathbb Q[\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2,a_1,\ldots,a_N,\widetilde m]$, and let $K_{N,m}=\operatorname{Frac}(R_{T_m})$. When the character-localized Borel–Moore concentration map and proper fixed-locus trace define $p_{k,*}^{\mathrm{loc}}$, set
$$I_{k,N}^{\mathrm{adj}}(\widetilde m)=p_{k,*}^{\mathrm{loc}}\bigl(\mathcal E_{\widetilde m}\cap[X_{k,N}^\zeta]_{K_m}\bigr)\in S_{T_m}^{-1}R_{T_m}\subset K_{N,m}.$$
This is a localized pushforward, not an ordinary pushforward along a nonproper map. The concentration isomorphism and trace are required inputs and are not asserted to exist by this definition.

When these data are supplied for every $k\geq0$, define the coefficientwise formal series
$$Z_{N,\mathrm{adj}}^{\mathrm{loc}}(q;\widetilde m)=\sum_{k\geq0}q^k I_{k,N}^{\mathrm{adj}}(\widetilde m)\in K_{N,m}\langle\!\langle q\rangle\!\rangle.$$
It has no asserted analytic convergence. In the source's Euclidean convention the real mass $m_E$ has mass dimension one, $m=i m_E$, and the equivariant mass is $\widetilde m=m+(\epsilon_1+\epsilon_2)/2$. For the adopted round $S^4_r$ model, $N=2$, $\epsilon_1=\epsilon_2=r^{-1}$, and hence $\widetilde m=i m_E+r^{-1}$. This mass shift is a source-qualified convention. The S4 postulate assumes a supersymmetry-compatible noncommutative regulator agreeing near each pole with the flat-space regulator; it does not construct that regulator or a continuum path-integral measure.

items.title: Explicit Rank-One One-Instanton ADHM Quotient

items.physical_scope: A finite-dimensional rank-one, charge-one stable ADHM quotient and its mass-twisted localized Borel–Moore coefficient. It makes no continuum gauge-theory claim.
items.axiom_base: ZF + the choice strength inherited from the normalized equivariant Borel–Moore and topological Chern/Euler suppliers; the finite scalar quotient calculation itself uses no choice.
items.design_state: Local complete scalar quotient and mass-inserted fixed-point proof added to support the rank-one B-page example.
items.statement:
Let $V=W=\mathbb C$, let $k=N=1$, and let $\mathcal S$ be the scalar ADHM data $(b_1,b_2,i,j)\in\mathbb C^4$ satisfying $ij=0$ and stability $i\ne0$. Let $GL(V)=\mathbb C^\times$ act by $(b_1,b_2,i,j)\mapsto(b_1,b_2,\lambda i,\lambda^{-1}j)$. The geometric quotient here means a surjective invariant morphism $\pi:\mathcal S\to X$ whose fibres are the $GL(V)$-orbits, for which $U\subseteq X$ is open exactly when $\pi^{-1}(U)$ is open, and for which $\mathcal O_X(U)\cong\mathcal O_{\mathcal S}(\pi^{-1}(U))^{GL(V)}$ for every open $U$. Let $T=(\mathbb C^\times)^2\times\mathbb C^\times_h$ act by $(t_1,t_2,h)\cdot(b_1,b_2,i,j)=(t_1b_1,t_2b_2,h^{-1}i,t_1t_2h j)$, and extend it by a flavor torus $\mathbb C_m^\times$ acting trivially on $X$. The quotient is isomorphic to $\mathbb C^2$ with coordinates $b_1,b_2$; its fixed locus under $T_m$ is the origin and its tangent characters there are $t_1,t_2$, with additive weights $\epsilon_1=c_1(t_1)$ and $\epsilon_2=c_1(t_2)$.

Let $K_m=(S^1)^2\times S_h^1\times S_m^1$ and use the product right Milnor model $E K_m$. Write $X_{K_m}=E K_m\times_{K_m}X$ with the diagonal quotient relation, and define $H_{T_m}^*(X;\mathbb Q)=H^*(X_{K_m};\mathbb Q)$. The derivative action makes $TX$ a rank-two equivariant complex vector bundle; its Borel descent, tensored with the inverse-flavor line $L_{-1}=E K_m\times_{K_m}\mathbb C_{\chi_m^{-1}}$, is a rank-two complex bundle over $X_{K_m}$. Let $\widetilde m=c_1(E K_m\times_{K_m}\mathbb C_{\chi_m})$. Here $c_i^{T_m}$ means the ordinary Chern class of this descended bundle, rationalized; for a numerable rank-$n$ bundle on a connected CW model, $c_i$ is defined by the unique projective-bundle relation $x_E^n-c_1(E)x_E^{n-1}+\cdots+(-1)^nc_n(E)=0$, where $x_E$ is the first Chern class of the tautological line on the projective bundle of fiber lines. The Borel base in this example is the total space of the rank-two bundle associated to the linear $T_m$-action on $\mathbb C^2$ over $B K_m=(\mathbb{CP}^{\infty})^4$; it deformation retracts to its zero section, and the descended bundle is numerable. At the origin the top Chern class restricts to $(\epsilon_1-\widetilde m)(\epsilon_2-\widetilde m)$, since top Chern equals the Euler class of the complex-oriented real bundle and the Euler class multiplies over the two character lines. Let $S_{T_m}$ be generated by first Chern classes of nontrivial integral characters, and use the character-localized proper-fixed-locus trace $p_*^{\mathrm{loc}}=p_{F*}\circ(i_*)^{-1}$ when the localized fixed-inclusion map $i_*$ is invertible; here $F=\{0\}$ is proper. The complex-oriented normalized Borel–Moore fundamental class $[X]_{K_m}$ has degree $4$. If the localized pushforward of $c_2^{T_m}(TX\otimes L_{-1})\cap[X]_{K_m}$ is defined, then the charge-one coefficient is
$$I_{1,1}^{\mathrm{adj}}(\widetilde m)=\frac{(\epsilon_1-\widetilde m)(\epsilon_2-\widetilde m)}{\epsilon_1\epsilon_2}.$$
At charge zero the quotient is a point with rank-zero insertion and coefficient $1$.

items.statement:
Fix $N\geq2$, $k\geq0$, and $\zeta>0$. Let $X_{k,N}^\zeta$ be the positive-FI stable complex ADHM quotient with rotation and dual-framing torus $T=(S^1)^2\times(S^1)^N$ acting by $(t_1,t_2,h)\cdot(B_1,B_2,I,J)=(t_1B_1,t_2B_2,Ih^{-1},t_1t_2hJ)$, where $\mathbf W=\sum_{\alpha=1}^N e_\alpha^{-1}$. Write $\epsilon_i=c_1^T(t_i)$ and $a_\alpha=c_1^T(e_\alpha)$, and assume these weights are algebraically independent. Let $q$ be dimensionless and formal. For an $N$-tuple of partitions $\vec Y=(Y_1,\ldots,Y_N)$, each $Y_\alpha$ a finite downward-closed subset of $\mathbb Z_{\geq0}^2$, put $|\vec Y|=\sum_\alpha|Y_\alpha|$, $\mathbf V_{\vec Y}=\sum_{\alpha=1}^N e_\alpha\sum_{(i,j)\in Y_\alpha}t_1^it_2^j$, and $\mathbf W^\vee=\sum_\alpha e_\alpha$. Assume the complexified torus acts algebraically on a smooth separated finite-type variety of complex dimension $2kN$, with a finite invariant affine atlas and finite proper fixed locus. Assume the fixed points and tangent characters are those in the positive-FI stable ADHM partition-fixed-point and tangent-character result. Extend $T$ by a flavor circle acting trivially on the quotient, with defining character $\chi_m$ and additive weight $\widetilde m=c_1(L_{\chi_m})$. Let $K_m=K\times S_m^1$ use the product right Milnor model, and set $X_{k,N,K_m}^\zeta=E K_m\times_{K_m}X_{k,N}^\zeta$ with the diagonal Borel quotient relation. Equivariant cohomology is $H^*(X_{k,N,K_m}^\zeta;\mathbb Q)$; its Chern classes are the rationalized ordinary Chern classes of the descended equivariant bundles, defined by the projective-bundle relation of the preceding Definition. At a fixed point with tangent characters of additive weights $w_\chi$, the top class $c_{2kN}^{T_m}(TX_{k,N}^\zeta\otimes L_{-1})$ restricts to $\prod_\chi(w_\chi-\widetilde m)$: the Borel fiber is the sum of character lines tensored by the inverse flavor line, and top Chern equals the Euler class of the complex-oriented real bundle, multiplicative over the ordered sum. Thus $\mathcal E_{\widetilde m}=c_{2kN}^{T_m}(TX_{k,N}^\zeta\otimes L_{-1})\in H^{4kN}(X_{k,N,K_m}^\zeta;\mathbb Q)$. Assume its localized Borel–Moore pushforward is defined by the proper-fixed-locus construction and satisfies the noncompact localization formula. For the source-reported N=2* convention, set $m=i m_E$ for real Euclidean mass $m_E$ and $\widetilde m=m+(\epsilon_1+\epsilon_2)/2$.

At a fixed point $\vec Y$, the tangent character is
$$\operatorname{ch}_T(T_{\vec Y}X_{k,N}^\zeta)=\mathbf V_{\vec Y}^{\vee}\mathbf V_{\vec Y}(t_1+t_2-1-t_1t_2)+\mathbf V_{\vec Y}^{\vee}\mathbf W^\vee+t_1t_2\mathbf W\mathbf V_{\vec Y}.$$
For each tangent character $\chi$, write $w_\chi=c_1^T(\chi)$ and let $E_{\vec Y}=\prod_\chi w_\chi$ and $N_{\vec Y}(\widetilde m)=\prod_\chi(w_\chi-\widetilde m)$, with multiplicities. Then the mass-inserted coefficient and formal series are
$$I_{k,N}^{\mathrm{adj}}(\widetilde m)=\sum_{|\vec Y|=k}\frac{N_{\vec Y}(\widetilde m)}{E_{\vec Y}},\qquad Z_{N,\mathrm{adj}}^{\mathrm{loc}}(q;\widetilde m)=\sum_{k\geq0}q^k\sum_{|\vec Y|=k}\frac{N_{\vec Y}(\widetilde m)}{E_{\vec Y}}\in\mathbb Q(\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2,a_1,\ldots,a_N,\widetilde m)\langle\!\langle q\rangle\!\rangle.$$

For the adopted round $S^4_r$ N=2* model, specialize to $N=2$, $\epsilon_1=\epsilon_2=r^{-1}$ and $\widetilde m=i m_E+r^{-1}$, with $q=e^{2\pi i\tau}$ on the model's continued Coulomb contour. The source assumes, but does not construct, the supersymmetry-compatible noncommutative S4 regulator agreeing near each pole with the flat-space regulator. The displayed identity is a formal fixed-point calculation for the regulated local factor; it does not prove existence of that regulator, a continuum functional measure, the full S4 partition function, or convergence of the series.
